description: Single source of truth for every detection rule. The scanner only runs rules listed here; tests fail if a rule has no query file or a query file has no rule.

rules.title: Unattached managed disk
rules.finds: Managed disks in the Unattached state with no owning VM
rules.typical_saving: 100% of the disk cost ($5-$135+ per disk per month)
rules.savings_formula: provisioned size (GB) x per-GB monthly list price for the disk SKU
rules.remediation: Confirm with the owner, take an incremental snapshot if the data may be needed, then delete the disk

rules.title: Unassociated public IP address
rules.finds: Static or Standard public IPs not attached to a NIC, load balancer, NAT gateway or gateway
rules.remediation: Check DNS records and allow-lists that reference the address, then delete it

rules.title: Stopped or deallocated VM still incurring cost
rules.finds: VMs stopped from inside the OS (compute still billed) or deallocated with disks still billed
rules.typical_saving: Full compute cost for 'stopped' VMs; disk cost for long-deallocated VMs
rules.savings_formula: sum of attached disk costs + VM size list price when power state is 'stopped' (not deallocated)
rules.remediation: Deallocate stopped VMs; for VMs deallocated for weeks, snapshot and delete or move disks to Standard HDD

rules.title: Snapshot older than 90 days
rules.finds: Managed disk snapshots older than 90 days
rules.savings_formula: snapshot size (GB) x per-GB snapshot price (upper bound; incremental snapshots bill used size)
rules.remediation: Move long-term retention to Azure Backup policies, then delete ad-hoc snapshots past retention

rules.title: App Service plan with no apps
rules.finds: Paid-tier App Service plans hosting zero sites
rules.savings_formula: plan SKU monthly list price x worker count
rules.remediation: Delete the empty plan or consolidate apps onto a shared plan

rules.title: Standard load balancer with no backends
rules.finds: Standard SKU load balancers that have rules configured but empty backend pools
rules.savings_formula: first 5 rules hourly rate x 730 + $0.01/h per additional rule
rules.remediation: Delete the load balancer or remove its rules (a Standard LB with zero rules is not charged)

rules.title: Legacy-generation VM size
rules.finds: VMs on older families (A, Av2, Dv2, DSv2, Dv3, Ev3, Fs, G) with better price-performance successors
rules.savings_formula: VM size list price x 15% (conservative price-performance gain of v5/v6 families)
rules.remediation: Resize to a current-generation equivalent during a maintenance window and validate performance

rules.title: Billable resource missing cost-allocation tags
rules.finds: Billable resources missing any of the owner, cost-center or environment tags
rules.typical_saving: Indirect: enables showback and owner follow-up on every other finding
rules.remediation: Add the missing tags; enforce with Azure Policy (modify/append tag inheritance from resource group)

rules.title: Orphaned network interface
rules.finds: NICs not attached to a VM, private endpoint or private link service
rules.typical_saving: Indirect: NICs are free but hold IP space and often keep public IPs alive
rules.remediation: Delete the NIC after confirming no automation recreates or reattaches it

rules.title: Unattached EBS volume
rules.finds: EBS volumes in the 'available' state (not attached to any instance)
rules.typical_saving: 100% of the volume cost ($0.015-$0.125 per GB-month plus provisioned IOPS)
rules.savings_formula: size x per-GB price + provisioned IOPS/throughput above the free baseline
rules.remediation: Snapshot (or archive-tier snapshot) if needed, then delete the volume

rules.title: Unassociated Elastic IP
rules.finds: Elastic IP addresses with no association
rules.remediation: Confirm the address is not in allow-lists or DNS, then release it

rules.title: EBS snapshot older than 90 days
rules.finds: Self-owned EBS snapshots older than 90 days, flagging AMI-backed and AWS Backup-managed ones
rules.savings_formula: volume size x snapshot price (upper bound; snapshots are incremental)
rules.remediation: Apply Data Lifecycle Manager or AWS Backup retention; archive or delete snapshots past retention

rules.title: Idle NAT gateway
rules.finds: NAT gateways that moved less than 1 GiB to destinations in the last 14 days
rules.typical_saving: ~$32.85 per gateway per month (hourly charge only)
rules.remediation: Remove the gateway and its routes, or consolidate to one gateway per VPC for non-production

rules.title: gp2 volume that should be gp3
rules.finds: In-use gp2 volumes that can be modified online to gp3
rules.savings_formula: gp2 cost - gp3 cost, provisioning gp3 IOPS/throughput to match the gp2 baseline
rules.remediation: aws ec2 modify-volume --volume-type gp3 (online, no downtime); match IOPS/throughput for large volumes

rules.title: Stopped EC2 instance still paying for EBS
rules.finds: Instances stopped for 7+ days whose attached EBS volumes keep billing
rules.typical_saving: 100% of attached volume cost if the instance is retired
rules.remediation: Create an AMI/snapshot, terminate the instance, or schedule it with office-hours start/stop

rules.title: Load balancer with no registered targets
rules.finds: ALB/NLB/GWLB with no target groups or zero registered targets, and Classic LBs with no instances
rules.typical_saving: $9-$18 per load balancer per month plus LCU charges
rules.remediation: Check DNS records pointing at the load balancer, then delete it
